response.sql: WITH overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(remaining) as avg_remaining FROM budget), status_avg AS (SELECT event_status, AVG(remaining) as avg_remaining FROM budget WHERE event_status IS NOT NULL GROUP BY event_status) SELECT s.event_status, s.avg_remaining, s.avg_remaining - o.avg_remaining as difference FROM status_avg s, overall_avg o WHERE o.avg_remaining IS NOT NULL
